sources.prompt: Edit this exact transparent reference sprite sheet. Preserve its grid, the exact existing object identities, silhouettes, poses, proportions and base palettes, and the visual identity of every paired top-row wearing layer / bottom-row inventory icon. Only polish the specified small material details. Do not redesign or add extra objects, birds, eyes, faces, text, labels, borders, backgrounds, cast shadows or ambient effects. Fully transparent RGBA background, including all holes; retain real transparent lens areas in the TOP wearable layer so a character's eyes will show through it. Top row is strict front-facing flat wearable art, bottom row retains the reference inventory perspective. Keep every object wholly in its own equal rectangular grid cell with generous transparent gutters, same cell ordering. One organic dark navy contour pen, clean two-tone cel shading with one upper-left highlight. No white outer fringe, no blur, no overall glow, no photorealism, no palette shift. Each small material accent occupies under eight percent of its object. This sheet has THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, exactly six objects. Column1 white astronaut helmet: preserve its white shell, blue-gray collar and clear face window. Add one thin curved visor reflection near the upper-left rim, exactly TWO tiny white star glints restricted to the top/rim of the visor, and a crisp white highlight to the chrome collar. The TOP window remains truly transparent and the BOTTOM icon keeps its existing dark blue interior. Do NOT paint milky fill over the top window. Column2 dark blue bent wizard hat: preserve hat angle, star positions and moon; make its existing golden stars stitched two-tone embroidery with a minuscule white glint on just one star, and a short moon highlight. Do NOT add a hat band or change its silhouette. Column3 gold laurel: same leaf shapes and open center, gold two-tone metal with small leaf-tip highlights; add precisely THREE small RED BERRIES nestled among the leaves inside its existing silhouette. These are the only red details. All three are legendary quality through tiny craftsmanship, not explosive sparkle.
